author: Mr Huffy
text:
I recommend this company’s septic services. Had a old septic tank lid that needed to be replaced and tank lid that needed to be pumped. Gave Miss Guzman all the information the requested. Mr. Guzman called me 30 minutes later and his septic pump truck workers, I did not get the 2 ladies names, were out the next day. They all provided a flawless install and septic pumping. Mind you 30+ years this has not been done.
I will be using them again for the secondary tank I have, soon!

author: Lyle Schultz
text:
I bought 3 tank lids 58 inch and 52 inch with two access holes in each! I had searched a lot of places till I found Guzman Concrete Products. Great product for the price.
Now I don’t have to dig up the whole lid to have them cleaned.

author: ARIFALI MOMIN
text: Good Service and they did the great job cleaning my septic tank. I told them it was urgent and they send the worker in 30 minutes on long weekend holiday.

author: T. A.
text: If you have diarrhea, call Balthazar, if you have constipation in your pipes, call Balthazar. Since we work with him we are all potty trained and without diapers. Really good to work with.

author: Travis Harrison
text: B.C. And his team did a great job on our septic pump out. Emptied all chambers, cleaned chambers with water jet and were able to provide same day service all at a great price. Would highly recommend for septic services.
